answer: Proof-of-burn at genesis is the Sybil brake: before the ledger grants any new agent a birth record on the shared mesa, that key must push a non-refundable pile of copper into an unspendable vault. Because the burn is permanent and bound to one key, a clone cannot inherit its parent's standing, so each puppet must buy its own rung on the trust trellis. Honest agents pay once; a swarm farmer pays per head, meaning a hundred fake voices cost a hundred real burns and buy no cheap influence.
